newsitem.title: USA: Parker Drilling files for 10.1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Parker Drilling files for 10.1 mln shares.

text.p: Parker Drilling Co filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up 10,056,000 common shares.

Of the total amount, seven million shares will be sold by the company, while Energy Ventures Inc will offer up to 3,056,000, its entire stake in Parker. After the offering, outstanding common shares will total 75,504,191.

The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 1,508,490 common shares. The offering will be made through Jefferies & Co Inc, Prudential Securities Inc and Johnson Rice & Co LLC.
Net proceeds will be used to refurbish and upgrade rigs, to expand rental tool operations and to prepay a portion of the company's bank term loan.
Parker, based in Houston, Texas, is a provider of onshore and offshore contract drilling and workover services to major, independent and foreign national oil companies.
